caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair viewed from the front, centered on a plain, light beige background without any additional objects or decorations. The chair features a medium brown wood frame with visible grain patterns. Its backrest is comprised of a horizontal top rail, an ornate central splat with a carved circular medallion in the middle, and two vertical supports. The seat appears to be woven cane or rush in a light tan color, forming a pattern of triangles converging toward the center. The chair legs are gently splayed outwards, with the front legs being slightly curved and the rear legs extending upward to form the backrest supports. Near the bottom right of the image, there is a small signature that reads "Helen Bronson."
title: Chair
